::: {#def-one-sample-t-test}
#### One-sample t-test

Let $\dsn{x}$ be observations with $n \ge 2$,
sample mean $\bar{x}$, and sample standard deviation $s$.
The **one-sample t-test** of $H_0: \mean = \mean_0$
against $H_1: \mean \neq \mean_0$ uses the statistic

$$t \eqdef \frac{\bar{x} - \mean_0}{s / \sqrt{n}}.$$

Its p-value is $\Pr(\abs{T} \ge \abs{t})$,
where $T$ has the $t_{n-1}$ distribution ([t-distribution](inference.qmd#def-t-dist)).
:::
